title: Training Note — Handover Condition Share of Ridgeline Special Order Services Delivery Charges on Deposit Programs
content:
The condition recorded at the customer handover sets the condition share of the home delivery charge on a delivered Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent.

**Clause.** A customer handover inspection that recorded damaged — functional or wrong item gives a condition share of 0; a customer handover inspection that recorded damaged — cosmetic, with none recording damaged — functional or wrong item, gives 0.75; otherwise the condition share is 1.

The delivery charge billed is multiplied by the condition share before its single rounding to the nearest cent; the share itself is never rounded.

## Questions answered by the clause

**Which inspections count?** Only condition records made at the customer handover on the order. A store receipt inspection does not enter the condition share.

**What if the handover records show both cosmetic damage and a wrong item?** The share is 0: one record of functional damage or of a wrong item is enough.

**What if the handover was recorded as good, or no handover inspection is on record?** The share is 1.

## Share table

| Customer handover records on the order | Condition share |
|---|---|
| any damaged — functional or wrong item | 0 |
| damaged — cosmetic only | 0.75 |
| good only, or none | 1 |

**Hypothetical figure.** A charge of 99.00 before the share becomes 74.25 with cosmetic damage only, and 0.00 with a wrong item.
